title: Knock interrupt — artificial rhythm broken; cost already present
throughline: An irregular knock breaks the controlled table loop. Source stays uncertain until the reflection shows the sister already eating alone. Oino hears, sees her failure, and still keeps her hand on the control.

policy.link_call_motif: CALL_05_ZONE_KNOCK / CALL_01 cousin — domestic irregularity, not scare
policy.note: Knock interrupts quantized reunion without becoming a jump scare. The sister's loneliness is already happening — not a warning of what might happen later.

possible_sources.label: the sister tapping downstairs
possible_sources.staging: Floor vibration / soft tap contour; may be true but not proven yet.

possible_sources.label: the attic door
possible_sources.staging: Wood shift / latch settle; memory of the door she once closed.

possible_sources.label: a bowl touching the table
possible_sources.staging: Ceramic contact; could be here or downstairs — space collapses in sound.

possible_sources.label: a machine responding to the melody
possible_sources.staging: Quiet architecture answers a note; industrial frame as sympathetic knock.

possible_sources.label: an unexplained force in the Zone
possible_sources.staging: CALL_05 cousin — Zone does not explain itself; keep ambiguous.

source_reveal.rule: Keep source uncertain until the reflection reveals the sister. Other candidates remain possible memories of the same interrupt.

rhythm.pattern: off-grid, incomplete call contour — breaks the exact-frame laugh loop
rhythm.relation_to_table: cuts artificial rhythm without a volume spike or scare sting
rhythm.bpm_feel: human / wrong-domestic; slightly behind or ahead of the loop grid

beats.staging: Downstairs table in reflection; sister present, still; place set for someone who has not come.
Two bowls readable in the glass — shared meal intended; one will stay hers alone.
Oino's place downstairs untouched — the cost is already set at the real table.

beats.image: the sister beginning to eat alone
beats.staging: She begins to eat alone; not a future threat — loneliness in progress. Anger may live under the motion.

oino_stages.action: She hears the interruption and tries to ignore it.

body.ears: registers off-grid knock against locked laugh loop
body.hand: pressure increases slightly on playback control — hold the loop

oino_stages.staging: No whip-pan to source. Head may tick toward sound then return. Desire protects the loop.
oino_stages.cost_read: Ignoring is already a choice against a living interrupt — not preparation for a later lesson.

oino_stages.action: She sees the sister and understands that she has repeated the ancestor's failure.

body.eyes: eyeline into PROP_ReflectiveSurface_Sister — waiting sister, two bowls, untouched place, eating alone
body.face: recognition without speech; archive-watcher failure now lived
body.hand: still on control but no longer only concealment — knowledge arrives

oino_stages.staging: Camera can favor CAM_TABLE_REFLECTION then Oino's eyes. Ancestor's implicated watching becomes her own control. Sister is a living person, not a moral prop.
oino_stages.cost_read: The failure is present-tense: sister already alone downstairs while Oino loops the father.

oino_stages.action: Her hand remains on the control because she still wants her father to stay.

body.hand: does not lift from PROP_PlaybackControl — want and knowledge coexist
body.eyes: may leave reflection back to father; soft and guilty
body.weight: rooted at the table; holy-fool release not yet chosen

oino_stages.staging: Hold on hand + eyeline. Merciful control becomes known cost. Do not force release in this beat — wanting him to stay is honest.
oino_stages.cost_read: Cost already exists (sister eating alone); her hand staying proves desire outweighs return — now, not later.

must_preserve: Knock breaks artificial rhythm without jump scare
Source uncertain until reflection reveals sister
Reflection shows waiting, two bowls, untouched place, sister eating alone
Three Oino stages: ignore → ancestor failure recognized → hand remains
Cost already exists — not a hypothetical warning
must_not: Turn sister into a moral prop only
Frame the loneliness as something that might happen later
Horror sting or monster at the door
